description: Land Aquisition - Malwatte, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla District.
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is land-related matters. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
